name: agent-memory
description: Lossless, tree-structured project memory: every session, edit and decision is kept, and only what the work needs is loaded into context, offloaded when done, and restored after compaction.

key_storage.title: Where the memory's encryption key lives
key_storage.description: key-file: a key file in your user config folder (default). passphrase: derived from the passphrase below, cached per login session. keychain: the OS keychain (needs the keyring package). Applies when a project's memory is first created.

passphrase.title: Passphrase (only for the passphrase option)
passphrase.description: Used only when key storage is 'passphrase'. Kept in your OS's secure storage by Claude Code.

profiles.title: Domain profiles
profiles.description: Comma-separated: generic (always on), software (code symbols, git, test results), documents (Markdown and reStructuredText structure).
